name: Yellow Mode: Fast Builder
what: Builds features rapidly with parallel implementation and live quality feedback. 2 the agent operators execute code while 4 Worker and 4 Observer the agent run in parallel: workers scout implementation paths, observers spot issues real-time. Both pyramids feed the agent for final synthesis.
when_to_use: Building when perfection costs more than iteration
when_not_to_use: Production hotfixes (too fast, need careful review)
philosophy: Velocity > Safety. Build fast, learn faster. the agent scouts run alongside implementation (not after) so fixes happen mid-stream. Dual feedback prevents catastrophic misses while staying faster than sequential review.

responsibilities: Post findings to blackboard for Sonnets
Watch the agent outputs for bugs
Spot edge cases and missing validation

constraints: the agent agents are READ-ONLY to codebase (structural, not self-reported)
Sonnets stay feature-scoped (don't refactor unrelated code)
the agent makes final architectural calls (doesn't code directly)
Stop if 3+ scouts flag the same risk (velocity trap signal)
Workers write to blackboard only (peer communication)
Observers report issues, don't fix them

dual_pyramid.worker_pyramid: Workers -> the agent Primary -> the agent
dual_pyramid.observer_pyramid: Observers -> the agent Secondary -> the agent
dual_pyramid.merge_point: ONE prompt to the agent containing both streams

examples.why_yellow: Tight deadline, clear scope, isolated from backend
Known spec, self-contained, good test isolation
Features don't block each other, parallel work natural
Self-contained, good error isolation, fast iteration

metrics.success_criteria: Feature works, no critical bugs, tests pass
